events.verdict: Finney-Smith (BKN) does not release his shot attempt before the expiration of the shot clock. A 24-second violation is correctly called.
Braun (DEN) establishes himself in a screening position in Finney-Smith's (BKN) path and absorbs the contact.
Braun (DEN) jumps vertically and legally contests the driving shot attempt by Thomas (BKN). Any contact with Thomas's hand after the release of his shot attempt is incidental.
Finney-Smith (BKN) legally contests Murray's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Braun (DEN) legally contests Thomas's (BKN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Claxton (BKN) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Jokic (DEN) in the post.
Jokic (DEN) commits a take foul on Finney-Smith (BKN).
Finney-Smith (BKN) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Jokic (DEN) in the post.
Jokic (DEN) legally contests Finney-Smith's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Schroder (BKN) reaches in and initiates contact to Gordon's (DEN) arm as he enters his upward shooting motion during the layup attempt.
Murray (DEN) reaches in and makes clean contact with ball as Schroder (BKN) is dribbling on the perimeter.
Finney-Smith (BKN) firms up in a screening position in Murray's (DEN) path and does not deliver contact.
Johnson (BKN) legally contests Porter Jr.'s (DEN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.

Schroder (BKN) steps into Porter Jr.'s (DEN) path and creates the marginal contact between the two players. Porter Jr. has a hand placed on Schroder's back, but Schroder begins to lose his balance on his own and not as a result of any illegal contact from Porter Jr.
Thomas (BKN) bobbles the ball attempting to gather and upon regaining possession, he immediately passes to a teammate.
Johnson (BKN) jumps from point A to point B into Murray's (DEN) body, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Finney-Smith (BKN) initiates illegal contact to Braun's (DEN) arm as he contests the dunk attempt.
Claxton (BKN) commits a take foul on Murray (DEN).
Thomas (BKN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and therefore, Denver should maintain possession.
Schroder (BKN) drives through Jokic's (DEN) space and dislodges him from his defensive position.
Thomas (BKN) commits a take foul on Gordon (DEN).

Murray (DEN) establishes himself in a legal guarding position in front of Thomas (BKN) and he does not move forward into him during his shooting motion. The marginal contact is created by Thomas extending his leg as part of his shooting motion.
